title: Phenmetrazines, aminorex / oxazolines, piperazines
disclaimer: Game catalog research. Unitless 0-100 inferences from public reports. Unknown scores are null, never 0. Not a manual. No recipes. No how-to-take. No milligram instructions. Families are chemically separate.

compounds.name: Phenmetrazine

feel.headline: The old heads' amphetamine. Diet-pill that escaped the bottle.

rush.note: Oral is a climb. Old street myth reserved the snap for other routes — flag only.

euphoria.note: Amphetamine-shaped lift, talk, appetite gone. 60s–70s prellies lore is real affection.

enjoyment.note: People sought it after the pharmacy stopped.

compulsiveness.note: Withdrawn as an anorectic because people would not leave it alone.

reinforcement.note: Historical street demand after medical withdrawal.

aftereffects.note: Crash / irritability inferred from class and withdrawal history.

psychosis_concern.note: Amphetamine-class risk; not a modern case-series star.

sleep.note: Insomnia is the point of an anorectic stim.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; historical slam talk exists — fail-state rumor, not a tutorial
compounds.npc_line: Prellies. Before the copies learned to lie.

sources.title: Rothman et al. phenmetrazine DAT/NET release

gaps: Modern first-person file is thin; most love is historical.

compounds.name: Phendimetrazine

feel.headline: The prescription leftover. Prodrug that becomes the prellie.

rush.note: Oral medicine energy.

euphoria.note: Thinner than phenmetrazine; fun is downstream after N-demethylation.

compulsiveness.note: Real abuse history, not RC-forum religion.

reinforcement.note: Script diversion exists; no cult.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok
compounds.npc_line: The script they still print. The magic already left.
gaps: Recreational trip-report volume is small next to Preludin lore.

compounds.name: 3-FPM

feel.headline: Clean-functional liar. Still ruins weekends.

rush.note: Oral is a work drug. Insufflation burns. Other routes get named as the snap — flag only.

euphoria.note: First hour lift, talk, fake empathy. Short; redose teases it back then you live in stimulation.

enjoyment.note: People bought the idea: file taxes, clean the flat, talk.

compulsiveness.note: Short action, repetition over hours or days, fast tolerance. Habit-forming talk in WHO/forums.

reinforcement.note: Wallets opened for years. Kit U headliner.

paranoia.note: Anxiety on the comedown and in STRIDA polydrug series.

aftereffects.note: Anxiety, fatigue, depression, irritability; 9–72 h onset talk, lingering toward a week in the Polish summary.

sleep.note: Insomnia listed among sought and leftover effects.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; insufflation burns; slam_only is a fail-state rumor (limb ischemia case) not a tutorial; vape_fav appears in one loud megathread as the fiendish snap

sources.title: Mayer et al. fluorinated phenmetrazines as MAT releasers
Adamowicz & Gieron 3-FPM on the Polish market

gaps: No controlled human study. STRIDA is polydrug. Do not treat PAL numbers as street IDs.

compounds.name: 4-FPM

feel.headline: The other fluoro. Characterized more than loved.

rush.note: In vitro DAT/NET releaser like 3-FPM. No human poem.

reinforcement.note: Kit U stamp, not a headliner.

cardiovascular.note: Assume class stim if a bag appears.

compounds.npc_line: Same crystal bag. Wrong fluorine. Nobody wrote home.

feel.headline: The isomer the paper needed. Not a product.

rush.note: Mayer 2018: yet to appear as a research chemical at time of writing.

compounds.name: 3-CPM

feel.headline: 3-FPM's heavier cousin. The crate, not the poem.

rush.note: DAT/NET releaser on paper. Human file empty.

reinforcement.note: Real 2022–23 NPS products (mostly trans-3-CPM).

compounds.npc_line: They swapped F for Cl after the functional one got heat.

sources.title: Identification of 3-CPM from NPS products and differentiation from 2-/4-CPM

gaps: Do not invent heavier-3-FPM as fact — NPC guess only.

feel.headline: Made so the lab could tell 3-CPM apart.

compounds.name: 4-CPM

feel.headline: Para-chloro reference standard.

gaps: Not reported as the thing in the packages.

compounds.name: 4-MPM

feel.headline: After 3-FPM. Vendor-real. Feel file still thin.

euphoria.note: In vitro SERT tilt vs parent — lab guess, not a roll report.

reinforcement.note: EMCDDA Oct 2015; two vendor samples confirmed.

compounds.npc_line: They put a methyl where the fluorine was. The reviews never arrived.

feel.headline: Meta-methyl stamp. One vendor bottle in the same paper.

rush.note: In vitro closer to phenmetrazine stim than 4-MPM.

reinforcement.note: EMCDDA July 2016.

feel.headline: Ortho isomer for the chromatogram.

rush.note: Authors found no prior market info.

compounds.name: 3-FPE

feel.headline: 3-FPM plus a carbon. One loud Bluelight chemist, not a wave.

rush.note: Sekio: quite similar to 3-FPM. One voice.

compounds.npc_line: They stretched 3-FPM. The cult stayed with the original.
gaps: No forensic monograph found in this pass.

compounds.name: G-130

feel.headline: Italian research morpholine. Museum shelf.

gaps: No RC-era seizure file found here. Do not promote to Kit U.

feel.headline: Old anorectic cousin. Not a Port Rook SKU.

compounds.name: Aminorex

feel.headline: Diet pill that closed a country. Recreational love never showed up.

rush.note: Stimulant / anorectic, not a 4-MAR memoir.

euphoria.note: Releaser on paper. Street poems almost none. Mostly medicine then levamisole metabolite.

reinforcement.note: Once misrepresented as 4-MAR to dodge a law — mislabel, not fandom.

aftereffects.note: Pulmonary arterial hypertension in susceptible people is the historical fail-state.

cardiovascular.note: Pulmonary hypertension epidemic is the reason the medicine died.

compounds.route_myth: mislabel (sold as 4-MAR in at least one 1991 report); also a minor levamisole-cocaine metabolite — not a secret roll
compounds.npc_line: The diet pill that drowned lungs. Nobody asked for an encore.
gaps: Almost no modern recreational report corpus.

compounds.name: 4-MAR

feel.headline: They named it Euphoria. For once the street name was not lying.

rush.note: Long climb, not a pyro snap. Duration is the point.

euphoria.note: Erowid titles are love letters. Meth-shaped lift plus a long clean plateau.

enjoyment.note: The human-love SKU on the aminorex wall. Late-80s underground; RC kids still ask for a revival.

compulsiveness.note: Night does not end so you redose less than mephedrone; people still chased the bag.

reinforcement.note: Emergency scheduling followed actual demand.

aftereffects.note: A whole day, sometimes into the next. Insomnia is the tax.

cardiovascular.note: One published fatality with heart/lung failure; family pulmonary-hypertension case in makers/users.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; Ice also means meth — mislabel / identity fight; cis vs trans often unknown on the street
compounds.npc_line: U4Euh. The one the forum still lights a candle for.
gaps: cis vs trans street identity often unknown. Ice name collides with meth.

compounds.name: 4,4'-DMAR

feel.headline: They printed ecstasy logos. The bag printed obituaries.

rush.note: House-party powder/pills; oral and insufflated.

euphoria.note: Long stim, sometimes MDMA-shaped warmth. Not empty. Then the deaths.

enjoyment.note: Peak existed; retrospective satisfaction collapsed after 2013–14.

compulsiveness.note: Redosed in party settings; duration and serotonin load punish that.

reinforcement.note: Market died of reputation, not boredom.

paranoia.note: Agitation, hallucinations, disorientation in clinical notes.

psychosis_concern.note: Agitation / hallucination cluster in EMCDDA notes.

cardiovascular.note: Cardiac arrest in EWN; NE-mediated cardiotoxicity in the official read.

compounds.route_myth: mislabel (sold as MDMA / ecstasy logos); OD
gaps: First-person file is smaller than the death file.

compounds.name: MDMAR

feel.headline: MDMA x 4-MAR on paper. Vendor donation, not a scene.

rush.note: Potent non-selective releaser in the dish.

reinforcement.note: Purchased sample ~90% cis. Little market-presence info.

aftereffects.note: Class risk if it ever floods — do not invent a roll.

compounds.npc_line: They hybridized the legend. Nobody threw the party.

feel.headline: Lab cousin. Rare EU ping.

reinforcement.note: Detected in the EU 2015; rarely a street drug.

feel.headline: Same 2015 EU ping. Not a memoir.

compounds.name: 4'F-4-MAR

feel.headline: Test-purchase fluoro. Sometimes mislabeled as a phenmetrazine.

reinforcement.note: Slovenian NFL test purchase, mostly trans, sold as 4-FPO.

compounds.route_myth: mislabel (4-FPO sticker; sometimes filed as phenmetrazine in chatter)
compounds.npc_line: The sticker said 4-FPO. The family is aminorex. Do not file it under 3-FPM.
gaps: Subjective file thin. Identity fights with Kit U.

feel.headline: McNeil anorectic leftover. Never a bag.
McNeil anorectic leftover. Never a bag.
Horse metabolite, not a product.

sources.title: Maier et al. 2018 (Ho et al. levamisole metabolism)

compounds.name: Pemoline

feel.headline: ADHD tablet that failed the liver exam. Not a party.

rush.note: Slow oral onset, no snap.

euphoria.note: Mild stim. Doping / study-drug, not rave.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok

sources.title: Gielsdorf 1982 pemoline / fenozolone / thozalinone in urine

compounds.name: Cyclazodone

feel.headline: 1960s analog that showed up in 2017 as a smart stim. Weak hug.

compulsiveness.note: Repeated because the work window is the product.

reinforcement.note: Uncommon in seizure trend reports.

aftereffects.note: Liver anxiety as a pemoline cousin.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok
compounds.npc_line: They sold it next to 3-FPM. It filed the paperwork. It did not throw the party.

compounds.name: N-methylcyclazodone

feel.headline: Cyclazodone that actually buzzes. Liver rumor included.

euphoria.note: More stim than parent. Still not 4-MAR.

enjoyment.note: NDEWS 2021–22 reddit bump as a supplement.

compulsiveness.note: Multi-day self-treatment in the lab-confirmed tox case.

reinforcement.note: Niche, not a flood.

aftereffects.note: Chorea, CK/ALT up in NACCT case; reddit liver talk.

cardiovascular.note: Tachycardia, wide QRS/QTc in confirmed case.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok

sources.title: Basile et al. NACCT 2022 NMC toxicity

gaps: Enjoyment inferred from nootropic framing, not a big Erowid vault.

feel.headline: Old European pemoline cousin. Doping-era name.
Old European pemoline cousin. Doping-era name.

compounds.name: 2-DPMP

feel.headline: Ivory Wave's long devil. Compulsive. Not loved.

euphoria.note: Stim is real; joy is not the memory.

enjoyment.note: People remember the length and the damage.

reinforcement.note: Infamous more than sought twice.

aftereffects.note: The come-down is a calendar, not an evening.

compounds.route_myth: mislabel (Ivory Wave / bath-salt packets sometimes actually MDPV)
compounds.npc_line: Still awake. Still not having fun.

sources.title: UK legal-high / Ivory Wave forensic era (secondary reviews)

gaps: Packet contents were a lottery. Agent 30 may expand pipradrols.

compounds.name: D2PM

feel.headline: Weaker pipradrol cousin. Headache more than magic.

compounds.npc_line: They stocked it because 2-DPMP got heat. The headache came free.

compounds.name: Pipradrol

feel.headline: Old European medicine stim. Parent of 2-DPMP.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok

compounds.name: Prolintane

feel.headline: 1960s EU stim. Dusty, not Flask.

rush.note: Not a pyro just because it has a pyrrolidine — do not collapse into Kit I.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok
gaps: Not a cathinone. Agent 30 may own a fuller tropane/odd-stim expansion.

compounds.name: BZP

feel.headline: Legal-high era. It was legal. That was the magic.

rush.note: Oral amphetamine-lite. Dirty coffee with ambition, not pyro.

euphoria.note: Real lift, talk, party energy. WHO: stimulant including euphoria.

enjoyment.note: Era love, not molecule love. NZ youth actually used it. Modern heads call it harsh.

reinforcement.note: Tens of millions of party pills sold in NZ by 2008.

paranoia.note: Agitation in hospital series, usually mixes.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; often a blend with TFMPP sold as legal ecstasy
compounds.npc_line: Party pill. The law was the high.

sources.title: UNODC ST/NAR/47 piperazines in seized materials

compounds.name: TFMPP

feel.headline: The half of the pill that made you nauseous on purpose.

rush.note: Not a stim snap.

enjoyment.note: Very few solo reports. Nausea, tremor, hallucinations.

compulsiveness.note: You chase the mix, not TFMPP. Animal data: low abuse potential.

reinforcement.note: WHO: critical review not warranted on dependence grounds.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; almost always stacked with BZP as legal ecstasy
compounds.npc_line: That's the twist they added so you'd think it was a roll.
gaps: Almost no one ate it as a single SKU on purpose after the first time.

compounds.name: mCPP

feel.headline: The hangover in a pill.

rush.note: There is no rush. There is a flu.

euphoria.note: Papers sometimes say euphoria. Users say anxiety, panic, headache, nausea.

reinforcement.note: Bought by accident, stamped as Molly.

paranoia.note: Anxiety and panic most frequent tox.

compounds.route_myth: mislabel (sold as ecstasy); oral_ok
compounds.npc_line: If the pill feels like tomorrow morning, it was mCPP.
gaps: A minority of old reports claim a warm body. Do not let that overwrite hangover consensus.

compounds.name: pCPP

feel.headline: Isomer homework. mCPP's shadow.

rush.note: MS can collide with mCPP.

reinforcement.note: Not sought as a product.

compounds.npc_line: Same hangover family. Wrong stamp on the chromatogram.

feel.headline: Ortho-chloro isomer. Easier MS tell than pCPP.

compounds.name: MeOPP

feel.headline: Quiet phenylpiperazine. Weak, weird, not a roll.

euphoria.note: Serotonergic, often dull or sedating vs BZP.

enjoyment.note: NZ scheduled it with the 2008 set. Standalone love: no.

reinforcement.note: Blend letter, not a SKU people asked for.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok
compounds.npc_line: They needed another letter for the blend.

sources.title: NZ Misuse of Drugs Act Schedule 3 (MeOPP listed)

compounds.name: pFPP

feel.headline: The grin they advertised. Milder than BZP, still a packet chemical.

euphoria.note: Marketed as smiley / MDMA-lite in leftover NZ brands.

enjoyment.note: More friendly than mCPP, less than a real roll.

reinforcement.note: Brand lore bigger than molecule lore.

aftereffects.note: Class nausea / headache possible. Not the mCPP villain.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; packet names The Big Grin / Extreme Beans / Retro pills / Lab-X are brands not extra molecules

sources.title: Piperazine derivatives as dangerous abused compounds

compounds.name: MBZP

feel.headline: BZP after the ban. Diet stim.

enjoyment.note: Replacement SKU, not a new religion.

reinforcement.note: NZ Class C with BZP.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok
compounds.npc_line: They methylated the legal high. The night got thinner.

sources.title: NZ Misuse of Drugs Act Schedule 3

compounds.name: MDBZP

feel.headline: MD-benzyl. Looks like a roll on the whiteboard. Wasn't.

reinforcement.note: Fipexide metabolite; seized as designer piperazine.

compounds.npc_line: They drew a methylenedioxy on BZP and waited for Molly. She did not come.

compounds.name: DBZP

feel.headline: The impurity, not the product.

rush.note: Shows up in BZP seizures as leftover.

reinforcement.note: Not a sought SKU.

compounds.npc_line: That peak is the leftover, not the party.

feel.headline: Fluoro-benzyl stamp. Forensic list, not a memoir.

rush.note: Benzyl column, stim-shaped on paper.

compounds.name: BZP+TFMPP party pill

feel.headline: It said herbal ecstasy on the tin. It was piperazine and optimism.

rush.note: BZP supplies the stim. Typical seized lore ~2:1 BZP:TFMPP — ratio is history, not a recipe.

euphoria.note: Fake-roll from the blend. Some nights were fine. Hangover included.

enjoyment.note: NZ 2000s cultural moment. Love of legality plus a night out.

compulsiveness.note: Stacked tins, not a pyro binge.

reinforcement.note: Estimated 26 million party pills sold in NZ by 2008.

aftereffects.note: Nausea from TFMPP plus BZP crash.

compounds.route_myth: oral_ok; mislabel (legal ecstasy / herbal ecstasy); packet names are brands not extra molecules
compounds.npc_line: Party pill. The law was the high.
gaps: Do not invent extra brand names. Do not treat Legal E as a compound ID.

combo_packets.feel: The actual product: BZP stim + TFMPP fake-roll. Era love. Hangover included.
Up to four piperazines. Kitchen-sink identity lottery.
pFPP + TFMPP. Serotonin blend, less BZP.
Often sold as ecstasy. Hangover city. Logos like Mitsubishi / Lacoste are stamps not extra SKUs.
